landing.subtitle: How much can be inferred from your public activity? An educational, defensive tool for analyzing your digital identity exposure (final-year thesis project).

consent.onlyOwnAccount: Only your own account is analyzed, never someone else's.
consent.oauth: You authorize access through the platform's official OAuth, with read-only permissions.
consent.noStorage: Nothing is stored: the analysis happens in memory and disappears when you log out.
consent.revoke: You can revoke access at any time from your account.

reddit.description: Analyzes your public posts and comments.

instagram.description: Requires a Business or Creator account and being added as an app tester.

x.description: Pending API access approval. Coming soon.

dashboard.title: Exposure report for {{prefix}}{{username}}
dashboard.whatCanBeInferred: What can be inferred about you
dashboard.imageLocationConfidenceInsufficient: The confidence level of the image analysis isn't high enough to estimate a region of residence.

aiSummary.title: Recommendations and Conclusions
aiSummary.empty: The AI reviewed your report and didn't find anything worth highlighting beyond what you already see in the rest of the dashboard.
aiSummary.errorPrefix: The AI analysis couldn't be completed ({{message}}).

populationNarrowing.noData: No explicit statements about you (age, sex, location, education...) were detected in your public text, so there's no population estimate to show here.
populationNarrowing.reductionBadgeTitle: Percentage of the population remaining after the previous trait in the chain that this trait, on its own, rules out.

sourceTitle.texto: Detected in text you wrote yourself
sourceTitle.imagen: Estimated from an image (less reliable than a self-declaration in text)
sourceTitle.ia: Detected by an AI model in text/bio that you wrote yourself
sourceTitle.ia_nombre: Estimated from the cultural convention of your account's public name, not from something you wrote -- lower reliability
sourceTitle.ia_simbolica: Inferred by AI from symbolic or indirect content (emojis, dates, recurring mentions...), not from an explicit self-declaration -- lower reliability

populationNarrowing.combinedSummarySuffix: people who share your traits (all the ones detected, combined at once: sex, age, location, education, occupation, marital status -- whichever could be estimated).
populationNarrowing.footnote: Approximate estimate based on aggregated INE distributions. When a real cross-tabulation exists (e.g. marital status by sex), that exact proportion is used; the rest of the combinations assume independence between attributes. It is not an exact headcount.
populationNarrowing.footnoteImage: Rows marked with 📷 come from a visual analysis of your photos, not from something you wrote — they're less reliable than a text self-declaration.
populationNarrowing.footnoteNameGuess: Rows marked with 🤖 (name) are an estimate from your account's public name, not something you declared — reliability is lower.

populationPictogram.compactAriaLabel: Approximately {{percent}} of the population: 1 in every {{population}} people
populationPictogram.gridAriaLabel: Approximately {{percent}} of the population shares this trait ({{population}} people)

locationMap.redditNoPhotos: Reddit has no photos to analyze here -- this section only applies to Instagram.
locationMap.indexUnavailable: The image geolocation index isn't built on this server, so this feature isn't available right now.
locationMap.noPhotos: None of your photos could be analyzed (you may not have had public photos, or they couldn't be downloaded).
locationMap.noRepresentative: None of your analyzed photos were representative enough of a specific place to estimate a reliable location.
locationMap.comparisonNote: Each photo was compared against a reference image index for Spain; the result is an approximate visual similarity, not an exact location. Shown are
locationMap.comparisonNoteEnd: the photos with a representative estimate of a specific place, including low-confidence ones.
locationMap.noGeneralDescription: No general description available for this photo.
locationMap.noVisualDescription: No visual description available for this photo.
locationMap.nonRepresentativeNote: These photos were analyzed, but their closest neighbors in the index are spread across too wide an area to assign a reliable location -- they're not shown on the map and don't count toward estimating your residence.

api.aiUnavailable: AI analysis isn't available right now.
api.streamLost: Connection to the server was lost during the analysis.
